shared_general_student.validation_partition: 10%; strict lower validation objective retains checkpoint; exact ties retain earlier checkpoint
shared_general_student.optimizer: fresh Adam (PyTorch defaults) per stage; gradient norm clipped to 10
shared_general_student.initialization: seeded 0.02*N(0,1) coefficients; zero biases except photo loss-branch biases=-3; gate prior clip(0.45+0.10*sensitivity,0.05,0.95)

stages.2: lr=0.001; temperature geometric 2->0.35; residual/complexity/binary weights each 1e-5
stages.3: lr=0.0005; hard mask; temperature=0.2; residual weight=5e-5; complexity=binary=0

I_dark.pruning: equal mechanism quota floor(B/(M+1)); residual receives remaining slots

I_photo.pruning: one anchor per mechanism, then global score order across mechanism/residual candidates; no generic terms and no reserved residual slots

AC_Response.teacher: fixed 500-pass finite-MC q_beta predictive mean (not parameter-mean KAN)
AC_Response.validation_partition: evaluation only; not used for structure/checkpoint selection
AC_Response.test_partition: opened once after hard pruning and refit
AC_Response.optimizer: one Adam optimizer, lr=0.02, PyTorch defaults; gradient norm clipped to 20
AC_Response.budget_definition: ten gated coefficients; excludes the ungated global exponent parameter log_p
AC_Response.pruning_score: abs(coefficient)*sigmoid(gate_logit); remaining slots in descending score
AC_Response.guards: fc in [0.02,500] GHz; f/fc floored at 1e-12; p=0.5+exp(clip(log_p,log(0.05),log(20)))

source_configs.AC_Response: historical run predates run_config serialization; effective values registered here
